channel.title: Restoration of a German M40 helmet Part 4 - Commentaires
channel.description: Next step after the rust was removed was sanding, filling, sanding, filling, sanding, filling, and so on, until the surface was smooth and ready for the primer. This process is the same as used for car restoration. This is the helmet after the primer was applied.
